title: Iman wheel template
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y4 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: iman wheel template)
intro: Lesson 13: Bridge: Iman and the six articles. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

cards: I try to do good every day
I stay calm when plans change
blocks.title: Sort into: Belief / Action it leads to
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Belief, Action it leads to.
blocks.answer: Belief: Angels write my deeds; The Last Day is real; Qadar; The Qur'an is Allah's word. Action it leads to: I speak kindly; I try to do good every day; I stay calm when plans change; I read it with respect

blocks.text: In each part of the wheel, write what the article means and one way it changes how you act.

keywords.def: beings made from light who obey Allah
people chosen by Allah to deliver His message
Allah's knowledge and plan for everything

questions.q: Write one sentence about each of the six articles.
questions.a: For example: I believe Allah is One; angels obey Allah; ...

questions.q: Make a six-section 'iman wheel': each section names an article and gives one action it leads to.
questions.a: Six sections, each with an article and a matching action.

questions.q: Extend: why do Muslims say in sha Allah?
questions.a: Because of belief in qadar: only Allah knows what will happen.

questions.q: Stretch: choose one article and explain how it helps a person who is sad.
questions.a: For example: qadar helps because Allah's plan is wise and He rewards patience.

questions.q: Which article means Allah knows and plans everything?
questions.a: A) Qadar. Qadar is Allah's decree. Angels and books are other articles.

questions.q: Which is NOT one of the six articles?
Think again: which belief will change how you act tomorrow, and how?
questions.a: For example: angels write my deeds, so I will speak kindly.
